<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="316" y1="13" x2="316" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="11" x2="321" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="9" x2="326" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="357" y="10" width="13" height="8" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="375" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="60" r="21" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
    <text x="31" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">AM</text>
    <text x="63" y="55" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Good morning</text>
    <text x="63" y="76" font-family="Roboto" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Alex Morgan</text>
    <circle cx="353" cy="60" r="19" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="347" y="55" width="12" height="11" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#0901A7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="52" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#0901A7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="49" r="4" fill="#3EB3F9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Title and actions -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="124" font-family="Roboto" font-size="25" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Bills</text>
    <text x="20" y="148" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Manage your bills and payment requests</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="169" width="168" height="48" rx="24" fill="#0275BA"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="193" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="56" y1="199" x2="62" y2="205" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="78" y="199" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Send</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="202" y="169" width="168" height="48" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="232" y1="187" x2="248" y2="187" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="240" y1="179" x2="240" y2="195" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="259" y="199" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Request</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Search and filter -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="237" width="350" height="44" rx="22" fill="#F7F9FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="257" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="262" x2="54" y2="268" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="68" y="262" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Search bills</text>
    <rect x="20" y="294" width="90" height="30" rx="15" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
    <text x="65" y="314" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0901A7">All bills</text>
    <rect x="118" y="294" width="104" height="30" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="170" y="314" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#676767">For later</text>
    <rect x="230" y="294" width="140" height="30" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="300" y="314" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#676767">Paid requests</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Empty state card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="352" width="350" height="2" rx="1" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="20" y="366" width="350" height="214" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="20" y="364" width="350" height="214" rx="18" fill="#F7FBFD"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="411" r="43" fill="#9FD9FC" opacity="0.55"/>
    <rect x="174" y="390" width="42" height="52" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="402" x2="207" y2="402" stroke="#3EB3F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="411" x2="207" y2="411" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="420" x2="199" y2="420" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="429" r="9" fill="#0275BA"/>

    <line x1="211" y1="424" x2="211" y2="434" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="195" y="502" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Bills and payment requests you receive</text>
    <text x="195" y="522" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">will appear here.</text>
    <text x="195" y="552" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Learn how bills work</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Helpful section -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="622" font-family="Roboto" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Quick actions</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="642" width="166" height="70" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
      <rect x="20" y="640" width="166" height="70" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="48" cy="675" r="17" fill="#FFD469"/>

      <text x="75" y="691" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">To friends or family</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="204" y="642" width="166" height="70" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
      <rect x="204" y="640" width="166" height="70" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="232" cy="675" r="17" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
      <polyline points="225,675 232,682 240,669" fill="none" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="259" y="671" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Request money</text>
      <text x="259" y="691" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Create a payment request</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="742" width="390" height="102" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="742" x2="390" y2="742" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="39,768 49,760 59,768" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="42" y="767" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="49" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Home</text>
    <!-- Payments -->
    <rect x="104" y="762" width="27" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="105" y1="768" x2="130" y2="768" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="124" cy="775" r="2" fill="#676767"/>
    <text x="117" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Payments</text>
    <!-- Bills selected -->
    <rect x="174" y="755" width="42" height="31" rx="15" fill="#9FD9FC" opacity="0.65"/>
    <rect x="184" y="762" width="21" height="20" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <text x="195" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Bills</text>
    <!-- Wallet -->
    <rect x="253" y="763" width="28" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="260" y="768" width="25" height="10" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="276" cy="773" r="2" fill="#676767"/>
    <text x="267" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Wallet</text>
    <!-- Activity -->
    <line x1="329" y1="779" x2="329" y2="770" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="779" x2="337" y2="763" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="779" x2="345" y2="767" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="326,774 333,769 340,772 348,762" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="337" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Activity</text>
    <rect x="166" y="828" width="58" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
